settings.heading: Shipping
settings.content: We've eliminated the guesswork behind calculating the cost of shipping. Our standard shipping options are simple: free shipping for all trim and sample orders, and $199 flat-rate curbside freight shipping.

settings.usp_content: Once you place your order and your floors are ready to ship, our team will assign you the best carrier based on your location and the size of your order. Your delivery will be By Appointment.
You will be contacted when the floors arrive to their terminal, and they typically aim to schedule deliveries within the week. You can ask for a window that best fits your scheduling needs.

settings.heading: How it works
settings.sub_heading: Flooret works with a variety of carriers to successfully deliver your floors.

settings.video_content: Thinking about ordering new flooring for your home? Here is everything you need to know about how curbside freight shipping works. Watch this video to ensure that you are ready to receive your shipment.

settings.content:
Nationwide Flat-Rate Curbside Shipping

We like to keep things simple. Our Premium Curbside Shipping Service follows this motto to a tee with $199 flat-rate shipping nationwide (excluding Alaska and Hawaii, see below) on all freight orders. Shipments will arrive in 4 to 8 business days. Online tracking and curbside delivery included.

Orders of 3 boxes or fewer are shipped FedEx Parcel, rather than Freight. Orders of this size are delivered to your front door and do not require a signature.

Samples Ship Free

All cut and full-size samples are shipped for free. Now you can view the design, feel the texture and test the durability of the floors you are most interested in without burdening yourself with something silly like the cost of shipping.

Alaska + Hawaii

Our $199 flat-rate shipping rate will get your floors to any freight forwarder in the lower 48 (most Alaska forwarders are based around Seattle/Tacoma, and Hawaii forwarders are most common around Long Beach/Los Angeles). We can recommend a forwarder, and they can provide a quote to your order's final destination. Contact us at 1-800-700-8122 for further assistance.

settings.accordion_title: How long will it take to receive my order?
settings.accordion_content:
Depending on the product you ordered, you can expect one of the following average delivery times:

  • Cut Sample Orders: 2-3 business days
  • Full-Sized Sample Orders: 3-5 business days
  • Freight Orders: 4-8 business days
  • Trim/Transition Orders: 4-8 business days

Already placed your order? Track it here.

Watch this helpful video on how the shipping process works!

settings.accordion_title: How much will it cost to ship my order?
settings.accordion_content:
We offer flat-rate freight shipping on all full orders for just $199 (excluding Alaska & Hawaii).

Samples and trim ship for free.

settings.accordion_title: Will the product be delivered inside my house?
settings.accordion_content: No. We currently only offer curbside freight delivery services, meaning your order will be dropped off at the curb in front of your home.

Once your order is placed, our team will determine the best carrier for your location and package your order for delivery.

The freight carrier will pick up your order, generate your tracking number, and get your floors on the way to you.

With By Appointment freight delivery, expect a phone call from the carrier to schedule a drop-off window.

settings.accordion_title: What do I need to know about Freight delivery?
settings.accordion_content: To get ready for delivery, we highly recommend watching our shipping videos. Once your order is delivered, be sure to review our Delivery Checklist before you sign off on the delivery.

settings.content: Allow our knowledgeable team to bring clarity to the seemingly complicated world of flooring. We are focused on simplifying the process of learning about, and buying, floors.
